You will hear three extracts. Choose the correct answer (A, B or C) for each question (24-29). There are TWO questions for each extract. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.

Extract One
*You hear part of a radio discussion about Monarch butterflies.*

items.q: According to the man, in what way do Monarch butterflies differ from other butterflies?
options: A) They fly very long distances.
B) They spend the winter in a warm climate.
C) They survive best at high altitude.

items.q: What does the man find surprising about Monarch butterflies?
options: A) They can only migrate once.
B) They migrate in large groups.
C) They migrate to a precise location.

Extract Two
*You hear two friends talking about the final of a cookery competition they saw on television.*

items.q: They agree that the winning contestant …
options: A) performed well at a crucial moment.
B) fully deserved to win the contest.
C) used an intriguing range of ingredients.

items.q: The woman thinks that yesterday's cookery programme could be improved by …
options: A) adding a new person to the judges' panel.
B) varying the format of the presentation.
C) specifying what style of cooking contestants must do.

blocks.text:
Extract Three
*You hear two friends discussing a trip to a game park in South Africa.*

items.q: Before the woman went to South Africa, the man had told her that …
options: A) the sheer size of the animals would be impressive.
B) the game park would be the highlight of the trip.
C) the sunsets were spectacular in this kind of landscape.

items.q: The woman thought the elephant approached their jeep because …
options: A) it wanted to warn them off.
B) it was searching for food.
C) it was simply curious.
